blessings.name: Path Resonance: Preservation
blessings.desc: Spend 100 points of Energy to use this ability and resonate with the Path of Preservation, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies based on the total Shield between all allies.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Zero-Dimensional Reinforcement
blessings.desc: The attacks of Path Resonance: Preservation become CRIT Hits. For every Shielded character on the team, the CRIT DMG increases by 15%.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Eutectic Reaction
blessings.desc: When Path Resonance is used, all allies gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 1% of their respective Max HP, for 2 turns, and Amber is applied to all allies at the same time.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Isomorphous Reaction
blessings.desc: When entering battle, Path Resonance regenerates 40% Energy. When an ally gains a Shield, Path Resonance additionally regenerates 3% Energy.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Spiked Armor
blessings.desc: There is a 150% base chance for Path Resonance: Preservation to inflict Bleed on the attacked target for 2 turn(s). Bleeding enemies will take Physical DoT equal to 12% of their Max HP at the start of each turn. This DMG cannot exceed 250% of the total amount of Shield Effect currently active on all allies.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Cold Snap
blessings.desc: When attacking Frozen enemy targets with Path Resonance: Preservation, the DMG dealt increases by 80% and the Freeze status on the enemy targets is removed. Dissociation will not be removed by this effect.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Reverse Quenching
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance, extends Shield duration by 2 turn(s) on characters whose current HP is below 50% of their Max HP. For every character on which this takes effect, this current use of the Path Resonance deals 20% more DMG.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Displaced Ascent
blessings.desc: Using the Ultimate increases the next Path Resonance's Physical RES PEN by 8%, stacking up to 8 time(s).

blessings.name: Divine Construct: Resonance Transfer
blessings.desc: After a character launches an attack, deals Quake DMG equal to 100% of the character's current Shield to the hit enemies.
blessings.enhanced: After a character launches an attack, deals Quake DMG equal to 100% of the character's current Shield Effect plus 20% of the total Shield Effect of the character's teammates to the hit enemies.

blessings.name: Divine Construct: Metastatic Field
blessings.desc: After a character is attacked, deals Quake DMG to the attacker, equal to 340% of the character's current Shield Effect. This DMG cannot defeat the enemy.
blessings.enhanced: After a character is attacked, deals Quake DMG to the attacker, equal to 420% of the character's Shield Effect just before the attack. This DMG cannot defeat the enemy.

blessings.name: Divine Construct: Macrosegregation
blessings.desc: At the start of the battle, characters gain a special Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 1% of their Max HP. Whenever another Shield is gained, this special Shield will also strengthen in equal value. For every 2 turn(s), this will be removed, and then this special Shield can be regained.
blessings.enhanced: At the start of the battle, characters gain a special Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 10% of their Max HP. Whenever another Shield is gained, this special Shield will also strengthen by 130%. For every 2 turn(s), this will be removed, and then this special Shield can be regained.

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Shear Structure
blessings.desc: Characters deal 10% increased Quake DMG to their target enemy, and enemies adjacent to it also take Quake DMG equal to 25% of DMG dealt to the primary target enemy.
blessings.enhanced: Characters deal 15% increased Quake DMG to their target, and other targets also take Quake DMG equal to 30% of DMG dealt to the primary target enemy.

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Burst Lattice
blessings.desc: When a character deals Quake DMG to an enemy target, there is a 65% base chance to cause the target to Bleed.
blessings.enhanced: When a character deals Quake DMG to an enemy target, there is a 100% base chance to cause the target to Bleed.

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Solid Solution
blessings.desc: Deals increased Quake DMG to enemies. The amount of DMG increased is equal to 80% of the character's current DEF.
blessings.enhanced: Deals increased Quake DMG to enemies. The amount of DMG increased is equal to 120% of the character's current DEF.

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Safe Load
blessings.desc: Shielded characters increase their ATK by 40% of the Shield Effect on them, up to a maximum of 120% of their Base ATK.
blessings.enhanced: Shielded characters increase their ATK by 60% of the Shield Effect on them, up to a maximum of 160% of their Base ATK.

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Sanctuary
blessings.desc: At the end of the turn, there is 80% fixed chance for characters to gain a Shield equal to 12% of their Max HP, lasting for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: At the end of the turn, characters gain a special Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 15% of their Max HP, lasting for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Quadrangular Pyramid
blessings.desc: Increase the max DMG that can be absorbed by Shields created by characters by 30%.
blessings.enhanced: When characters' gain a Shield, increases the max DMG that can be absorbed by the Shield by 35%.

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Hypoeutectoid
blessings.desc: When a character provides Shields to allies, this character gains a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 24% of the provided Shield for 2 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: When a character provides Shields to allies, this character gains a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 36% of the provided Shield for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Construct: Assemble
blessings.desc: Characters gain a 6% DEF increase for each Preservation Blessing, stacking up to a max of 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: Characters gain a 8% DEF increase for each Preservation Blessing, stacking up to a max of 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Construct: Sentinel
blessings.desc: Upon entering battle, characters gain a Shield equal to 16% of their Max HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: Upon entering battle, characters gain a Shield equal to 24% of their Max HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Construct: Patch
blessings.desc: After a character is attacked, they gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 18% of the HP lost during this attack, lasting for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character is attacked, they gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 18% of the HP lost during this attack, lasting for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Construct: Compensation
blessings.desc: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, characters gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 14% of their Max HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, characters gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 18% of their Max HP, lasting for 3 turn(s).

blessings.name: Construct: Firmness
blessings.desc: Shielded characters take 16% less DMG.
blessings.enhanced: Shielded characters take 24% less DMG.

blessings.name: Construct: Rotation
blessings.desc: When a character gains a Shield, there is a 20% fixed chance to dispel 1 debuff that is currently placed on the character.
blessings.enhanced: When a character gains a Shield, there is a 30% fixed chance to dispel 1 debuff that is currently placed on the character.

blessings.name: Construct: Burst
blessings.desc: Increases the CRIT DMG of Shielded characters by 30%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases the CRIT DMG of Shielded characters by 45%.

blessings.name: Construct: Concentration
blessings.desc: Increases the CRIT Rate of Shielded characters by 16%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases the CRIT Rate of Shielded characters by 24%.

blessings.name: Path Resonance: Remembrance
blessings.desc: Spend 100 points of Energy to use this ability and resonate with the Path of Remembrance, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies with a 120% base chance to Freeze all enemies for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Total Recall
blessings.desc: When Path Resonance is used, there is a 150% base chance to decrease enemies' chance to resist Frozen by 100% for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Rich Experience
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance, there is a 150% base chance to apply Eonian River to all enemies for 1 turn.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: First Love Once More
blessings.desc: Upon battle entrance, Path Resonance regenerates 40% Energy. When an enemy becomes Frozen, Path Resonance additionally regenerates 5% Energy.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Faces Places
blessings.desc: When the Freeze effect caused by Path Resonance is dispelled or resisted by enemy targets, there is a 150% base chance of lowering the target's All-Type RES by 15% for 2 turn(s). For every 1% HP that each ally has lost, the target's All-Type RES is additionally lowered by 0.06%.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Landscape in the Mist
blessings.desc: When the Freeze effect caused by Path Resonance is dispelled or resisted by enemy targets, there is a 150% base chance of decreasing the target's SPD by 15% for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Roar and Rustle
blessings.desc: When the Freeze effect from the Path Resonance is dispelled or resisted, characters gain a Shield equal in strength to 40% of their Max HP for 2 turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once by each use of the Path Resonance.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Seemingly Mirrored
blessings.desc: Basic ATKs against enemies Frozen by the Path Resonance have a 100% base chance to inflict Dissociation on them for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Perfect Experience: Fuli
blessings.desc: When attacking Frozen enemies, there is a 100% base chance to inflict Dissociation for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: When attacking Frozen enemies, there is a 100% base chance to apply Dissociation to the enemy for 1 turn(s). DMG dealt when Dissociation is removed +20%.

blessings.name: Perfect Experience: Innocence
blessings.desc: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, there is a 100% base chance to apply Dissociation on the enemy for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, there is a 100% base chance to apply Dissociation on the enemy for 1 turn(s). This effect ignores enemies' chance to resist Frozen.

blessings.name: Perfect Experience: Reticence
blessings.desc: After an enemy is attacked 6 time(s), they have a 120% base chance to become Frozen for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After an enemy is attacked 5 time(s), they have a 150% base chance to become Frozen for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Ultimate Experience: Melancholia
blessings.desc: Attacking an enemy with Dissociation will remove Dissociation, and deal DMG equal to 150% of the Dissociation removal DMG.
blessings.enhanced: Attacking an enemy with Dissociation will remove Dissociation, and deal DMG equal to 200% of the Dissociation removal DMG.

blessings.name: Ultimate Experience: Dizziness
blessings.desc: Increases the DMG taken by enemies with Dissociation by 36%. This effect will remain for 1 turn after Dissociation is removed.
blessings.enhanced: Increases the DMG taken by enemies with Dissociation by 54%. This effect will remain for 1 turn after Dissociation is removed.

blessings.name: Ultimate Experience: Insensitivity
blessings.desc: After Dissociation is removed from an enemy, there is a 50% base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After Dissociation is removed from an enemy, there is a 75% base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Ultimate Experience: Sentimentality
blessings.desc: After an enemy receives Ice DMG, enemies adjacent to it also receive DMG equal to 20% of the DMG taken by the target enemy.
blessings.enhanced: After an enemy receives Ice DMG, all other enemies also receive DMG equal to 24% of the DMG taken by the target enemy.

blessings.name: Ultimate Experience: Indelibility
blessings.desc: When a character deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 2.0% base chance to Freeze the hit enemy for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: Enemies' chance to resist Frozen decreases by 20%. When a character deals DMG to an enemy, there is a 2.5% base chance to Freeze the hit enemy for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Ultimate Experience: Shudder
blessings.desc: After a character uses their Ultimate, there is a 70% base chance to apply Ice Weakness to a random enemy for 2 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character uses their Ultimate, there is a 70% base chance to apply Ice Weakness to a random enemy who has no Ice Weakness for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Ultimate Experience: Maverick
blessings.desc: Upon entering battle, there is a 150% base chance for all enemies to become Frozen for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: Upon entering battle, there is a 150% base chance for all enemies to become Frozen and have their SPD reduced by 30%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Experience: Unspeakable Shame
blessings.desc: For every Blessing of Remembrance the team has, enemies' chance to resist Frozen decreases by 6%, stacking up to 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: For every Blessing of Remembrance the team has, enemies' chance to resist Frozen decreases by 8%, stacking up to 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Experience: The Torment of Alienation
blessings.desc: Characters' Effect Hit Rate increases by 16%.
blessings.enhanced: Characters' Effect Hit Rate increases by 24%.

blessings.name: Experience: Lost Memory
blessings.desc: When attacks reduce an enemy's HP percentage to a point that is lower than 50% for the first time in this battle, there's a 70% base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: When attacks reduce an enemy's HP percentage to a point that is lower than 50% for the first time in this battle, there's a 100% base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Experience: Stone Cold Hatred
blessings.desc: When a character uses their Skill or Ultimate to attack a Frozen enemy, DMG for this attack increases by 36%.
blessings.enhanced: When a character uses their Skill or Ultimate to attack a Frozen enemy, DMG for this attack increases by 54%.

blessings.name: Experience: Pain & Suffering
blessings.desc: Right after an enemy is Frozen, the next 1 attack(s) launched against the said enemy will have 100% increased CRIT Rate. This effect is dispelled when the Frozen state is removed.
blessings.enhanced: Right after an enemy is Frozen, the next 2 attack(s) launched against the said enemy will have 100% increased CRIT Rate. This effect is dispelled when the Frozen state is removed.

blessings.name: Experience: Primordial Hardship
blessings.desc: Increases the DMG taken by Frozen enemies by 16%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases the DMG taken by Frozen enemies by 24%.

blessings.name: Experience: Thrill of Escalation
blessings.desc: When a character Freezes an enemy, regenerates 8 Energy. This effect may only trigger once per action.
blessings.enhanced: When a character Freezes an enemy, regenerates 12 Energy. This effect may only trigger once per action.

blessings.name: Experience: Responsive Excitement
blessings.desc: When a character applies Freeze to an enemy, the character gains a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 16% of their Max HP for 3 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: When a character applies Freeze to an enemy, the character gains a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 24% of their Max HP for 3 turn(s).

blessings.name: Path Resonance: Nihility
blessings.desc: Spend 100 points of Energy to use this ability and resonate with the Path of Nihility, with a 80% base chance to apply Burn, Shock, Bleed, and 2 stacks of Wind Shear on all enemies for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: The Doubtful Fourfold Root
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance, increases the base chance of applying statuses by 100% and the duration of statuses by 1 turn, and adds 1 stack to all stackable statuses.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Suffering and Sunshine
blessings.desc: The attacks of Path Resonance: Nihility have a 100% base chance to inflict 2 stacks of Confusion and 2 stacks of Devoid on all enemies for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Outsider
blessings.desc: When entering battle, Path Resonance regenerates 40% Energy. When an enemy receives DoT, Path Resonance additionally regenerates 2% Energy.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Off the Beaten Track
blessings.desc: After using a Path Resonance, for every type of debuff (out of Burn, Shock, Bleed, and Wind Shear) the enemy target is currently inflicted with, Advance Forward all allies' actions by 4%.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: White Nights
blessings.desc: A character's Basic ATK can cause all DoTs currently applied on the target via Path Resonance: Nihility to immediately deal DMG equivalent to 40% of these statuses' original DMG.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Reign of Keys
blessings.desc: Path Resonance deals 30% more DMG to Frozen enemies. When enemy targets become Frozen, DoTs applied by the Path Resonance extend their duration by 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Terror and Tremble
blessings.desc: For each unique Type of non-DoT DMG the enemy target has taken, Path Resonance deals 6% more DMG to it, lasting until the end of the turn.

blessings.name: Funeral of Sensory Pursuivant
blessings.desc: Every time an enemy takes DMG from a DoT, applies 1 stack(s) of Suspicion.
blessings.enhanced: Every time an enemy receives DoT, apply 1 stack(s) of Suspicion. Suspicion stacks will not be reduced.

blessings.name: The Man in the Cover
blessings.desc: Every time an enemy is afflicted with a DoT, apply 3 stack(s) of Suspicion.
blessings.enhanced: Every time an enemy is afflicted with a DoT, apply 3 stack(s) of Suspicion. Every time the DoT refreshes, apply 1 stack(s) of Suspicion.

blessings.name: Why Hasn't Everything Already Disappeared?
blessings.desc: At the beginning of an enemy's turn, trigger extra DoT 1 times, dealing DMG equal to 90% of the original DoT.
blessings.enhanced: At the beginning of an enemy's turn, trigger extra DoT 1 times, dealing DMG equal to 135% of the original DoT.

blessings.name: Beginning and End
blessings.desc: When an enemy inflicted with Suspicion is defeated, inflicts the same number of stacks of Suspicion the defeated enemy has on 1 random enemy target(s).
blessings.enhanced: When an enemy inflicted with Suspicion is defeated, inflicts the same number of stacks of Suspicion the defeated enemy has on 2 random enemy target(s).

blessings.name: Café Self-Deceit
blessings.desc: When an enemy has Suspicion on them, inflicts 1 extra stack(s) of Suspicion.
blessings.enhanced: When an enemy is inflicted with Suspicion, the stacks it gains are doubled.

blessings.name: Call of the Wilderness
blessings.desc: For every stack of Suspicion the enemies have, reduces their ATK by 0.3%, up to a max of 30%.
blessings.enhanced: For every stack of Suspicion the enemies have, reduces their ATK by 0.4%, up to a max of 30%, and reduces their Effect RES by 0.4%, up to a max of 30%.

blessings.name: Night Beyond Pyre
blessings.desc: Increases characters' Weakness Break Efficiency by 30%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases characters' Weakness Break Efficiency by 45%.

blessings.name: Hell is Other People
blessings.desc: When a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, the same type of Weakness Break effect is applied to enemies adjacent to it.
blessings.enhanced: When a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, the same type of Weakness Break effect is applied to all enemies.

blessings.name: Twilight of Existence
blessings.desc: When hitting a Weakness Broken enemy, there is a 75% base chance to apply Burn, Shock, Bleed, or Wind Shear on the enemy for 2 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: When hitting a Weakness Broken enemy, there is a 75% base chance to inflict Burn, Shock, Bleed, or Wind Shear on the enemy for 2 turn(s), and dispels 1 debuff currently on the attacker.

blessings.name: All Things are Possible
blessings.desc: If an enemy is attacked while under any DoT statuses, a random DoT will be triggered, dealing DMG equal to 100% of the DoT.
blessings.enhanced: If an enemy is attacked while under any DoT statuses, a random DoT will be triggered, dealing DMG equal to 150% of the DoT.

blessings.name: Ignosticism
blessings.desc: Gains a 6% DoT increase for each Nihility Blessing. This effect can stack up to a max of 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: Gains a 8% DoT increase for each Nihility Blessing. This effect can stack up to a max of 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Questioning of Purpose
blessings.desc: Increases characters' Break Effect by 50%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases characters' Break Effect by 75%.

blessings.name: Blind Vision
blessings.desc: Reduces enemies' Effect RES by 12%.
blessings.enhanced: Reduces enemies' Effect RES by 18%.

blessings.name: Tragic Lecture
blessings.desc: Increases DoT taken by enemies by 10%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases DoT taken by enemies by 15%.

blessings.name: Sensory Labyrinth
blessings.desc: Extends the duration of Wind Shear, Bleed, Shock, and Burn on enemies by 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: Extends the duration of Wind Shear, Bleed, Shock, and Burn on enemies by 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Emotional Decluttering
blessings.desc: Every time an enemy target is afflicted with a DoT status, the DMG taken by them increases by 3%. This effect can stack up to 4 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: Every time an enemy target is afflicted with a DoT status, the DMG taken by them increases by 4%. This effect can stack up to 5 time(s).

blessings.name: Offerings of Deception
blessings.desc: Every time an enemy takes DMG from a DoT, all allies restore HP equal to 1.0% of their respective Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: Every time an enemy takes DMG from a DoT, all allies restore HP equal to 1.5% of their respective Max HP.

blessings.name: Before Sunrise
blessings.desc: Every time an enemy receives a DoT, 2.0 Energy is regenerated for a random ally.
blessings.enhanced: Every time an enemy receives a DoT, 3.0 Energy is regenerated for a random ally.

blessings.name: Path Resonance: Abundance
blessings.desc: Spend 100 points of Energy to use this ability and resonate with the Path of Abundance, restore HP for all allies by 50% of their respective Max HP, and increases their respective Max HP by 15% for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Terminal Nirvana
blessings.desc: When any ally receives lethal DMG, the Resonance of Path of Abundance prevents them from being knocked down and automatically consumes all Energy to release Path Resonance. This effect can trigger up to 1 time(s) per battle.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Anicca
blessings.desc: After releasing a Path Resonance, removes all characters' debuffs and applies 1 stack(s) of Subduing Evils for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Anatta
blessings.desc: After Path Resonance Energy is consumed for the first time in battle for the use of Path Resonance, the Path Resonance for Abundance will appear in the Action Order. The Outgoing Healing provided by this Resonance decreases by 30%. When this Resonance takes action, it will automatically release Path Resonance 1 time to heal allies.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Mountain High
blessings.desc: After a character has their HP restored via Path Resonance and if the healing amount exceeds the maximum HP, recover 1 Skill Point. This effect can only trigger 1 time per Path Resonance use. After triggering this effect, all DMG dealt by all allies is increased by 30% for 2 turns. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Nullifying Ardor
blessings.desc: After using Path Resonance, all allies' Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 15% and Break Effect increases by 50%. This effect lasts for 2 turn(s) and stacks up to 2 time(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Fleeting Samadhi
blessings.desc: For every 1% of healing from Path Resonance that exceeds a character's Max HP, the character deals 1% increased Ultimate DMG. This effect is stackable, up to a maximum of 100%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Destined Death
blessings.desc: Healing from Path Resonance that exceeds a character's Max HP is stored and will be released as automatic healing when the character's HP falls below 35% of their Max HP. Up to 50% of the character's Max HP (when the Path Resonance is used) can be stored.

blessings.name: Perennial Prosperity, Lush Longevity
blessings.desc: Charges Dewdrop when a character receives healing. The Charge value is equal to 100% of the amount of HP restored.
blessings.enhanced: Charges "Dewdrop" when a character receives healing. The Charge value is equal to 100% of the amount of HP restored. Moreover, increases the DMG of "Dewdrop" by 40%.

blessings.name: Mudra of Blessing
blessings.desc: Charges "Dewdrop" at the beginning of a character's turn. The Charge value is equal to 60% of their current HP.
blessings.enhanced: Charges "Dewdrop" at the beginning of a character's turn. The Charge value is equal to 70% of their Max HP.

blessings.name: All Abundance in One Mind
blessings.desc: When a character provides healing, ally targets other than the healed target will also gain HP equal to 30% of the HP restored.
blessings.enhanced: When a character provides healing, allies other than the healed target will also restore HP equal to 30% of the amount of HP restored. Increases the ATK of all allies by 15% of the amount of HP restored, stacking up to no more than 80% of each ally's respective Base ATK and lasts until the end of the next turn.

blessings.name: Sin Dead, Grace Born
blessings.desc: Restores HP to the character equal to 20% of the Charge value when "Dewdrop" ruptures, up to 18% of the character's Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: Restores HP equal to 20% of the Charge value when "Dewdrop" ruptures, up to 24% of the character's Max HP and no less than 12% of their Max HP.

blessings.name: The Blessed Many
blessings.desc: When a character's HP is full, increases the Charging Efficiency for "Dewdrop" by 80%.
blessings.enhanced: When a character's HP is full, increases the Charging Efficiency for "Dewdrop" by 120%.

blessings.name: Salvation From Damnation
blessings.desc: When a "Dewdrop" breaks, there is a 65% fixed chance to remove 1 debuff on the character.
blessings.enhanced: When a "Dewdrop" breaks, there is a 100% fixed chance to remove 1 debuff on the character.

blessings.name: Candlelight Radiance
blessings.desc: When a character provides healing to allies, increases the ATK of both units by 50% for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: When a character provides healing to allies, increases the ATK of all allies by 50% for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Bitter Is the Bane
blessings.desc: After launching attacks, characters deal Additional DMG equal to 36% of their current HP.
blessings.enhanced: Whenever a character attacks, deals Additional DMG to the enemy equal to 42% of the character's Max HP.

blessings.name: Corporeal Pellucidity
blessings.desc: When a character's HP is full, reduces their DMG taken by 36%.
blessings.enhanced: When a character's HP is full, reduces their DMG taken by 36%, and increases their Effect RES by 27%.

blessings.name: Prajna Voyage
blessings.desc: When being healed by an ally target, characters restore extra HP equal to 30% of the amount of HP restored.
blessings.enhanced: When being healed by an ally target, characters restore extra HP equal to 45% of the amount of HP restored.

blessings.name: Dharma Rain
blessings.desc: For each Abundance Blessing, increase allies' respective Max HP by 5%. This effect can stack up to a max of 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: For each Abundance Blessing, increase allies' respective Max HP by 7%. This effect can stack up to a max of 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Dew Delight
blessings.desc: Characters' HP restored increases by 12%.
blessings.enhanced: Characters' HP restored increases by 18%.

blessings.name: Extended Life
blessings.desc: Upon entering battle, characters restore HP equal to 24% of their Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: Upon entering battle, characters restore HP equal to 36% of their Max HP.

blessings.name: Mudra
blessings.desc: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, restores HP to the character equal to 16% of their Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, restores HP to the character equal to 24% of their Max HP.

blessings.name: Peril Parry
blessings.desc: After a character is healed, increases their DEF by 24% for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character is healed, increases their DEF by 36% for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Back to Life
blessings.desc: After a character provides healing, they restore HP equal to 12% of their Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per action.
blessings.enhanced: After a character provides healing, they restore HP equal to 18% of their Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per action.

blessings.name: Force Victoire
blessings.desc: After a character is healed, increases their SPD by 10% for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character is healed, increases their SPD by 15% for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Empower
blessings.desc: After a character provides healing, there is a 30% fixed chance to recover 1 Skill Point. This effect can only trigger once per action.
blessings.enhanced: After a character provides healing, there is a 45% fixed chance to recover 1 Skill Point. This effect can only trigger once per action.

blessings.name: Path Resonance: The Hunt
blessings.desc: Spend 100 points of Energy to use this ability and resonate with the Path of The Hunt, dealing Wind DMG to all enemies based on the current ATK of the character currently with the highest ATK.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Star Hunter
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance, the ally with the highest ATK will be given a turn instantly and be granted Light-Hunting Celestial Arrow, lasting until this ally uses any ability.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Bow and Arrow
blessings.desc: When Path Resonance: The Hunt deals damage, enemies whose HP is lower than 50% are guaranteed to receive CRIT Hits, with the CRIT DMG at 50%. When the enemy is defeated, regenerates 50% Energy.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Perfect Aim
blessings.desc: Increase the Energy limit of Path Resonance from 100 to 200 points. When an ally's turn starts, additionally regenerates 3% Energy for Path Resonance.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Startling Breeze
blessings.desc: After using Path Resonance, all allies' SPD increases by 25 for 2 turn(s). This effect also applies to units summoned by allies.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Shooting Starfire
blessings.desc: After enemy target(s) are defeated by a Path Resonance, restores all allies' HP equal to 50% of their respective Max HP.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Solemn Snare
blessings.desc: For every Skill Point recovered by allies, the next Path Resonance deals 20% more DMG, stacking up to 8 time(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Waiting with Drawn Bow
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance, allies' Shield duration extends by 5 turn(s).

blessings.name: Empyrean Imperium
blessings.desc: When a character's turn begins, they gain 1 stack(s) of Critical Boost.
blessings.enhanced: When a character's turn begins, they gain 1 stack(s) of Critical Boost and increases the stack limit of Critical Boost to 12.

blessings.name: Radiant Supreme
blessings.desc: After a character defeats an enemy, their action is Advanced Forward by 100%. At the beginning of the next turn, they gain 4 stack(s) of Critical Boost.
blessings.enhanced: After a character defeats an enemy, their action is Advanced Forward by 100%. At the beginning of the next turn, they gain 7 stack(s) of Critical Boost.

blessings.name: Sovereign Skybreaker
blessings.desc: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, their action Advances Forward by 100% and increases the DMG dealt by their next attack by 50%.
blessings.enhanced: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, their action Advances Forward by 100% and increases the DMG dealt by their next attack by 75%. If the Weakness Broken enemy is an Elite Enemy, then Action Advances for all allies.

blessings.name: Skyward Vendetta
blessings.desc: If a character has higher than 100% CRIT Rate and currently has "Critical Boost," for every 1% CRIT Rate that exceeds 100%, CRIT DMG increases by 3%. CRIT DMG can be increased this way by a max of 150%.
blessings.enhanced: If a character has higher than 100% CRIT Rate and currently has "Critical Boost," for every 1% CRIT Rate that exceeds 100%, CRIT DMG increases by 3%. For every stack of "Critical Boost," CRIT DMG increases by an extra 0.2%. CRIT DMG can be increased this way by a max of 200%.

blessings.name: Archery Duel
blessings.desc: When a character's turn begins, every stack of Critical Boost restores the character's HP equal to 5% of their Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: When a character's turn begins, or after they used their Ultimate, restores the character's HP equal to 5% of their Max HP for every stack of Critical Boost.

blessings.name: Adept's Bow
blessings.desc: When any ally uses their Ultimate, they can inherit Critical Boost, and the number of Critical Boost stacks increases by 1.
blessings.enhanced: When any ally target uses their Ultimate or performs a Follow-Up ATK, they can inherit "Critical Boost," and the number of "Critical Boost" stacks increases by 1.

blessings.name: Mistwraith Pursuit
blessings.desc: When the same character acts consecutively, their ATK increases by 40%. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: When the same character acts consecutively, their ATK increases by 40%. This effect can stack up to 2 times and gives a 50% fixed chance to recover 1 Skill Point. This effect cannot be triggered repeatedly.

blessings.name: Starlit Hunt
blessings.desc: When a character defeats an enemy, regenerates Energy equal to 60% of the character's Max Energy.
blessings.enhanced: When a character defeats an enemy, regenerates Energy equal to 100% of the character's Max Energy.

blessings.name: Borisin Chase
blessings.desc: After every 6 turn(s) conducted by all allies, the current character's action is Advanced Forward by 100%. The effect cannot be triggered repeatedly by the same character.
blessings.enhanced: After every 6 turn(s) conducted by all allies, the current character's action is Advanced Forward by 100%. The effect cannot be triggered repeatedly by the same character. Upon entering battle, 5 turn(s) are considered to have already passed.

blessings.name: Rainbow Fang
blessings.desc: When a character defeats an enemy, restores their HP equal to 48% of their Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, restores HP equal to 18% of their Max HP. When a character defeats an enemy, restores HP equal to 48% of their Max HP.

blessings.name: Vermeil Bow and White Arrow
blessings.desc: For every Blessing from The Hunt, increases SPD by 3%. This effect can stack up to a max of 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: For every Blessing from The Hunt, increases SPD by 4%. This effect can stack up to a max of 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Sit Life, Hit Death
blessings.desc: Increases CRIT Rate by 11%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases CRIT Rate by 16%.

blessings.name: Stay High, Strike Low
blessings.desc: Increases CRIT DMG by 20%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases CRIT DMG by 30%.

blessings.name: Thundering Chariot
blessings.desc: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, delays the enemy's action by 20%.
blessings.enhanced: After a character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, delays the enemy's action by 30%.

blessings.name: Constellation Surge
blessings.desc: Upon entering battle, characters' SPD increases by 30% until they are attacked.
blessings.enhanced: Upon entering battle, characters' SPD increases by 45% until they are attacked.

blessings.name: Astral Menace
blessings.desc: At the end of a character's turn, their next action is Advanced Forward by 8%.
blessings.enhanced: At the end of a character's turn, their next action is Advanced Forward by 12%.

blessings.name: Arboreal Volley
blessings.desc: At the beginning of a character's turn, they regenerate 4 Energy.
blessings.enhanced: At the beginning of a character's turn, they regenerate 6 Energy.

blessings.name: Arrow Shades Bow
blessings.desc: At the beginning of a character's turn, receives an ATK boost equal to 10% of the last-acting ally's ATK. This will last until the next turn starts.
blessings.enhanced: At the beginning of a character's turn, receives an ATK boost equal to 15% of the last-acting ally's ATK. This will last until the next turn starts.

blessings.name: Path Resonance: Destruction
blessings.desc: Spend 100 points of Energy to use this ability and resonate with the Path of Destruction, dealing Fire DMG to all enemies based on the current HP difference between Max HP and current HP for all allies combined.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Cataclysmic Variable
blessings.desc: Using a Path Resonance will consume HP from all allies until their HP is equal to 40% of their respective Max HP, increasing the DMG of Path Resonance: Destruction by 20%. The amount of HP consumed will be converted into a Shield lasting for 2 turn(s), with the same Shield value as the HP lost.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Extreme Helium Flash
blessings.desc: The attacks of Path Resonance: Destruction have a 150% base chance to inflict Entropic Retribution on the enemy target for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Event Horizon
blessings.desc: When an ally whose current HP percentage is below 35% gets attacked, automatically releases 1 Path Resonance without consuming Energy. This effect can be triggered up to a max of 2 time(s) in a single battle and cannot be triggered multiple times by the same attack.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Substellar Belt
blessings.desc: Using Path Resonance will cause any character with current HP percentage lower than 50% to gain a Shield equal to 40% of their Max HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Zero Age Main Sequence
blessings.desc: When a character launches a Follow-Up ATK, regenerates 5% Energy for Path Resonance. If the character's current HP percentage is lower than 50%, additionally regenerates 5% Energy for Path Resonance.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Nuclear Implosion
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance to attack, additionally deals a set amount of DMG to all enemy targets whose HP is below 20% of their Max HP, reducing these targets' HP to 1.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Protostar
blessings.desc: After losing HP due to allies or Path Resonance effects, the characters gain Healing Over Time that lasts 2 turn(s). At the start of every turn, restore HP equal to 30% of the consumed HP.

blessings.name: Non-Inverse Antimatter Equation
blessings.desc: If a character's current HP percentage is below 50%, they are considered to have 16 extra stacks of Grit.
blessings.enhanced: If a character's current HP percentage is below 50%, they are considered to have 20 extra stacks of Grit. For every 10% further HP lost, gains 2 extra stack(s) of Grit.

blessings.name: Universal Heat Death Characteristic
blessings.desc: When characters are hit or are losing HP, they gain 4 stack(s) of Grit. When the turn ends, the character loses 4 stack(s) of Grit.
blessings.enhanced: When characters are hit or are losing HP, the character gains 4 stacks of Grit, and adjacent allies gain 1 stacks of Grit. When the turn ends, the character loses 4 stacks of Grit.

blessings.name: Regression Inequality of Annihilation
blessings.desc: When player characters are hit, DMG taken by the characters is distributed among all allies.
blessings.enhanced: Receives 15% less DMG. When player characters are hit, DMG taken by the characters is distributed among all allies.

blessings.name: Incremental Doomsday
blessings.desc: After being hit, for each stack of Grit the character has, the character deals Additional DMG equal to 4% of their ATK to the attacker. This DMG will not be able to defeat the enemy.
blessings.enhanced: After being hit, for each stack of Grit the character has, the character deals Additional DMG equal to 4% of their ATK plus 2% of the current HP loss to the attacker. This DMG will not be able to defeat the enemy.

blessings.name: Catastrophic Resonance
blessings.desc: If a character attacks while having Grit, consumes HP equal to 10% of current HP and deals Additional DMG equal to 60% of the HP lost.
blessings.enhanced: If a character attacks while having Grit, consumes HP equal to 10% of current HP and deals Additional DMG equal to 60% of the HP lost. For each stack of Grit, deals Additional DMG equal to 1% of the HP lost.

blessings.name: Indicative Depth of Field
blessings.desc: For each stack of Grit, reduces the DMG taken by the character by 0.8%.
blessings.enhanced: For each stack of Grit, reduces the DMG taken by characters by 0.8%. Grit can stack up to 45 time(s).

blessings.name: Devastating Accretion
blessings.desc: For every 1% of the difference between a character's Max HP and current HP, their ATK increases by 0.8%.
blessings.enhanced: For every 1% of a character's Max HP that is lost, their ATK increases by 0.8% and DEF by 0.5%.

blessings.name: Destructive Flare
blessings.desc: When a character's HP percentage is lower than 50%, deals 40% increased DMG.
blessings.enhanced: When a character's HP percentage is lower than 50%, deals 50% increased DMG. When HP's lower than 35%, DMG dealt further increases by 20%.

blessings.name: Disciplinary Flicker
blessings.desc: If an ally target's current HP percentage is lower than 35% after being attacked or consuming HP, restores their HP by 12% of their Max HP. This can restore HP equal to a maximum of 36% Max HP during a single action.
blessings.enhanced: If an ally target's current HP percentage is lower than 35% after being attacked or consuming HP, restores their HP by 20% of their Max HP. This can restore HP equal to a maximum of 50% Max HP during a single action.

blessings.name: Hazardous Lucent Residue
blessings.desc: After a character uses their Ultimate, they gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 25% of the HP difference between their Max HP and current HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character uses their Ultimate, they gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 25% of the HP difference between their Max HP and current HP, plus 7% of their Max HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Primordial Black Hole
blessings.desc: Characters gain a 5% ATK increase for each Destruction Blessing. This effect can stack up to a max of 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: Characters gain a 7% ATK increase for each Destruction Blessing. This effect can stack up to a max of 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Reflection
blessings.desc: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming downed, characters immediately restore HP by 1% of their Max HP. The allied team can only trigger this effect 1 time(s) per battle.
blessings.enhanced: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming downed, characters immediately restore HP by 30% of their Max HP. The allied team can only trigger this effect 1 time(s) per battle.

blessings.name: Orbital Redshift
blessings.desc: Increases Max HP by 16%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases Max HP by 24%.

blessings.name: Instability Strip
blessings.desc: When characters are hit or have lost HP, 4 Energy is regenerated.
blessings.enhanced: When characters are hit or have lost HP, 6 Energy is regenerated.

blessings.name: Metric Reservation
blessings.desc: Upon entering battle, characters gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 36% the HP difference between the character's Max HP and current HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: Upon entering battle, characters gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 54% the HP difference between the character's Max HP and current HP, lasting for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Sentinel Satellite
blessings.desc: When a character's HP percentage is lower than 50%, they gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 20% of their Max HP for 2 turn(s). This effect can only be triggered 1 time(s) by each character per battle.
blessings.enhanced: When a character's HP percentage is lower than 50%, they gain a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 30% of their Max HP for 2 turn(s). This effect can only be triggered 1 time(s) by each character per battle.

blessings.name: Polarization Receptor
blessings.desc: For every 1% of HP lost by a character, their DEF increases by 0.40%.
blessings.enhanced: For every 1% of HP lost by a character, their DEF increases by 0.60%.

blessings.name: Eternally Collapsing Object
blessings.desc: For every 1% of HP lost by a character, their Effect RES increases by 0.30%.
blessings.enhanced: For every 1% of HP lost by a character, their Effect RES increases by 0.45%.

blessings.name: Path Resonance: Elation
blessings.desc: Can consume 100 points of Energy to use the ability and resonate with the Path of Elation, dealing Follow-Up ATK DMG of a random Type to all enemies for 3 – 5 time(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Doomsday Carnival
blessings.desc: When Path Resonance: Elation deals DMG, there is a 150% base chance to apply Sensory Pursuit to enemies for 1 turn.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Dance of Growth
blessings.desc: Increase the Energy limit of Path Resonance from 100 to 200 points. Using abilities to resonate with a Path will consume all Energy. For every 20% Energy consumed that exceeds the original limit, attacks will deal DMG for 1 extra time.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Instant Win
blessings.desc: When entering battle, Path Resonance regenerates 40% Energy. When a character launches a Follow-Up ATK, Path Resonance additionally regenerates 5% Energy.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: The Taste of Anglerfish
blessings.desc: When Path Resonance: Elation deals DMG, randomly dispels 1 debuff on 1 ally.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Guinea Pig in Ice Coffin
blessings.desc: When Path Resonance: Elation deals Ice DMG, there is a 150% base chance to Freeze the enemy target for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Unending Night
blessings.desc: When Path Resonance deals Fire/Wind/Physical/Lightning DMG, there is a 50% base chance to apply a DoT of the same Type, lasting for 1 turns.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Pit and Pendulum
blessings.desc: When using the Path Resonance, for every 20 Energy consumed, the ally with the highest ATK and all units summoned by allies will have their action Advanced Forward by 10%.

blessings.name: Auto-Harmonica: Whitest Night
blessings.desc: After a character launches a Follow-Up ATK, they deal "Aftertaste" DMG equal to 55% of their ATK for 1 to 3 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character launches a Follow-Up ATK, they deal "Aftertaste" DMG equal to 60% of their ATK for 1 – 3 time(s). Moreover, increases "Aftertaste" DMG by 35%.

blessings.name: Slaughterhouse No. 4: Rest in Peace
blessings.desc: When characters launch Follow-Up ATKs to an enemy, deals "Aftertaste" DMG equal to 80% of their ATK to the enemy being hit. If the enemy also has their Weakness Broken, then deals DMG for 1 extra time(s).
blessings.enhanced: When characters launch Follow-Up ATKs to an enemy, deals "Aftertaste" DMG equal to 80% of their ATK to the enemy being hit. If the enemy also has their Weakness Broken, then deals DMG for 2 extra time(s).

blessings.name: Champion's Dinner: Cat's Cradle
blessings.desc: When a character uses Ultimate to deal DMG to an enemy target, it is considered as Follow-Up ATK. Increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATKs by 15%.
blessings.enhanced: When a character uses Ultimate to deal DMG to an enemy target, it is considered as Follow-Up ATK. Increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATKs by 55%.

blessings.name: Portrait of A Man On Fire
blessings.desc: When causing Aftertaste DMG to an enemy, characters deal additional Aftertaste DMG of different Types for 1 time(s), at DMG values equal to 60% of the original DMG.
blessings.enhanced: When causing Aftertaste DMG to an enemy, characters deal extra Aftertaste DMG of different Types for 1 time(s), at DMG values equal to 90% of the original DMG.

blessings.name: Just Keep on Crying!
blessings.desc: For every 1 Type of Aftertaste DMG the enemy received, increases the DMG taken by them by 8% until the end of their next action.
blessings.enhanced: For every 1 Type of Aftertaste DMG the enemy received, increases the DMG taken by them by 12% until the end of their next action.

blessings.name: The Hourglass Kindergarten
blessings.desc: For every 1 Type of Aftertaste DMG the enemy received, reduces their ATK by 4% until the end of their next action.
blessings.enhanced: For every 1 Type of Aftertaste DMG the enemy received, reduces their ATK by 6% until the end of their next action.

blessings.name: The Painted Albatross
blessings.desc: For each enemy target hit by a character's Follow-Up ATK, the character deals Additional DMG equal to 24% of their ATK to all enemies hit.
blessings.enhanced: For each enemy target hit by a character's Follow-Up ATK, the character deals Additional DMG equal to 36% of their ATK to all enemies hit.

blessings.name: 12 Monkeys and Angry Men
blessings.desc: When a character deals Follow-Up ATK DMG to an enemy target, the Follow-Up ATK DMG within this attack increases by 4%.
blessings.enhanced: When a character deals Follow-Up ATK DMG to an enemy target, the Follow-Up ATK DMG within this attack increases by 6%.

blessings.name: Aiden Gravitational Rainbow
blessings.desc: When a character launches Follow-Up ATKs on enemies, the enemies' action is delayed by 12%.
blessings.enhanced: When characters launch Follow-Up ATKs on enemies, the attacked enemies' actions are delayed by 12%, and there is a 10% base chance to cause Imprisonment on the enemies, lasting for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Twenty-First Military Rule
blessings.desc: After a character launches Follow-Up ATKs, there is a 65% fixed chance to recover 1 Skill Point.
blessings.enhanced: After a character launches Follow-Up ATKs, there is a 100% fixed chance to recover 1 Skill Point.

blessings.name: Exemplary Conduct
blessings.desc: For each Elation Blessing in possession, increases characters' Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by 9%. This effect can stack up to 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: For each Elation Blessing in possession, increases characters' Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by 12%. This effect can stack up to 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Mostly Harmful
blessings.desc: The Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 35% when characters deal Follow-Up ATK DMG.
blessings.enhanced: The Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 50% when characters deal Follow-Up ATK DMG.

blessings.name: Suspiria
blessings.desc: Increases characters' Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by 26%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases characters' Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by 39%.

blessings.name: Pale Fire
blessings.desc: Increases the CRIT Rate for Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by characters by 26%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases the CRIT Rate for Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by characters by 39%.

blessings.name: Back to the Lighthouse
blessings.desc: When a character deals DMG to an enemy with a Follow-Up ATK, increases their Energy Regeneration Rate by 24%.
blessings.enhanced: When a character deals DMG to an enemy with a Follow-Up ATK, increases their Energy Regeneration Rate by 36%.

blessings.name: Doctor of Love
blessings.desc: After a character launches a Follow-Up ATK, restores their HP by 10% of their Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: After a character launches a Follow-Up ATK, restores their HP by 15% of their Max HP.

blessings.name: Platinum Age
blessings.desc: After characters launch Follow-Up ATKs, increase their DEF by 40% for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After characters launch Follow-Up ATKs, increase their DEF by 40% for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Clockwork Apple
blessings.desc: After characters launch Follow-Up ATKs, increases SPD by 16% for 1 turn(s).
blessings.enhanced: After characters launch Follow-Up ATKs, increases SPD by 16% for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Path Resonance: Propagation
blessings.desc: Consumes 100 Energy to resonate with the Path of Propagation and allows a target ally to immediately take action, recover 2 Skill Point(s) and become affected by Metamorphosis. Metamorphosis lasts for 1 turn and only takes effect on the latest target.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Proboscis
blessings.desc: Extends the duration of Metamorphosis for 1 turn. After a character with Metamorphosis defeats an enemy, Path Resonance regenerates 20% Energy.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Phenol Compounds
blessings.desc: Increase the Energy limit of Path Resonance from 100 to 200 points. After a character consumes or recovers Skill Points, additionally regenerates 1.0% Energy for Path Resonance.

blessings.name: Resonance Formation: Crystal Pincers
blessings.desc: Metamorphosis additionally increases DMG dealt by a character by 40%. Only when a character is under the Metamorphosis effect can they cause Spores to burst. Every time a character causes 1 Spore to burst, additionally deals Basic ATK DMG equal to 80% of the character's ATK. This effect can trigger up to 3 time(s) on the same target.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Superposition Eye
blessings.desc: After using Path Resonance, nullifies all DMG received by a single target ally except DoT. This status is dispelled after being attacked. If the target ally's current HP percentage is lower than 50% when Path Resonance is used, it will additionally recover 1 Skill Point(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Adherent Microbial Mat
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance, a single target ally gains a Shield equal to 60% of Max HP, lasting for 3 turn(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Compounded Macrospore
blessings.desc: When using Path Resonance, heals the target ally for 50% of their Max HP. 200% of the healing that exceeds Max HP will be evenly distributed among other characters.

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Condensation Cavity
blessings.desc: Characters in the Metamorphosis status deal 20% more DMG to Frozen enemies. In addition, their attacks have a 10% base chance to Freeze hit targets for 1 turns.

blessings.name: Spore Discharge
blessings.desc: For each Skill Point a character consumes, all enemies will gain 1 Spore(s).
blessings.enhanced: For each Skill Point a character consumes, all enemies will gain 1 Spores. When all Skill Points are consumed, the SPD of the character who consumed the last Skill Point increases by 20% for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Fungal Pustule
blessings.desc: For each Skill Point recovered, apply 1 Spore to 2 random enemy target(s).
blessings.enhanced: For each Skill Point recovered, apply 1 Spore to 2 random enemy target(s). The max number of Spores that can be possessed increases to 9.

blessings.name: Scythe Limbs
blessings.desc: After a character uses their Ultimate, the next time they consume Skill Points, it will be considered as 1 additional Skill Point being consumed. For each Skill Point consumed, the character's CRIT DMG increases by 40%. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s), lasting until the character uses an attack.
blessings.enhanced: After a character uses their Ultimate, the next time they consume or recover Skill Points, it will be considered as 1 additional Skill Point being consumed or recovered. For each Skill Point consumed or recovered, the character's CRIT DMG increases by 45%. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s), lasting until after the character uses an attack.

blessings.name: Putrefaction Ulcer
blessings.desc: Changes the number of times Spores can spread after bursting to 2 times. Can also spread to the original bearer of Spores.
blessings.enhanced: Changes the number of times Spores can spread after bursting to 3 times. Can also spread to the original bearer of Spores.

blessings.name: Lytic Enzyme
blessings.desc: Increases the DMG caused by Spores bursting. The DMG increased is equal to 35% of the original DMG. After the target enemy was defeated, the Spores they were carrying will spread to targets adjacent to them.
blessings.enhanced: Increases the DMG caused by Spores bursting. The DMG increased is equal to 50% of the original DMG. After the target enemy was defeated, the Spores they were carrying will spread to other enemy targets.

blessings.name: Metabolic Cavity
blessings.desc: For each Spore that bursts, heals the character with the lowest HP percentage by 10% of their Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: For each Spore possessed by all enemies, reduces the DMG received by all allies by 0.8%, After the Spores burst, heals the ally with the lowest HP percentage by 12% of their Max HP.

blessings.name: Excitatory Gland
blessings.desc: If the team has 0 Skill Points when an ally uses their Basic ATK, additionally recovers 1 Skill Point.
blessings.enhanced: If the Skill Point is 0 when using Basic ATK, additionally recovers 1 Skill Point and has a 50% fixed chance of further recovering 1 Skill Point.

blessings.name: Exposed Brain Matter
blessings.desc: DMG dealt by characters' Basic ATK also deals DMG equal to 30% of the original DMG to a random adjacent target.
blessings.enhanced: DMG dealt by characters' Basic ATK also deals DMG equal to 35% of the original DMG to adjacent targets.

blessings.name: Intersegmental Membrane
blessings.desc: For each Skill Point a character consumes, the DMG received by them decreases by 8% for 1 turn(s). This effect can be stacked up to 2 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: For each Skill Point a character consumes, the DMG received by them decreases by 8% for 1 turn(s). This effect can be stacked up to 3 time(s).

blessings.name: Catalyst
blessings.desc: After a character uses their Skill and if the Skill did not unleash an attack, all allies' DMG dealt increases by 20% for 1 turn(s). This effect can be stacked up to 3 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: After a character uses their Skill and if the Skill did not unleash an attack, all allies' DMG dealt increases by 30% for 1 turn(s). This effect can be stacked up to 3 time(s).

blessings.name: Osseus Blade
blessings.desc: For each Blessing of Propagation in possession, increases all characters' Basic ATK DMG by 9%. This effect can stack up to 6 time(s).
blessings.enhanced: For each Blessing of Propagation in possession, increases all characters' Basic ATK DMG by 12%. This effect can stack up to 9 time(s).

blessings.name: Resonance Interplay: Data Reinforcement
blessings.desc: Attacks against Weakness Broken enemies do not reduce the available Synapse Resonance count.

blessings.name: BCI-34 Gray Matter
blessings.desc: When entering battle, charges the Brain in a Vat by 65%. Breaking an enemy's Weakness charges the Brain in a Vat by 35%.
blessings.enhanced: When entering battle, charges Brain in a Vat by 100%. Breaking an enemy's Weakness or attacking Weakness Broken enemies will charge Brain in a Vat by 40% or 5% respectively. This effect can only be triggered once by each enemy during each attack.

blessings.name: SMR-2 Amygdala
blessings.desc: Dealing fatal DMG to enemies will charge the Brain in a Vat by 50%.

blessings.name: VEP-18 Occipital Lobe
blessings.desc: The All-Type RES PEN for the Ultimate DMG dealt by characters increases by 20%. When an Ultimate is used, for every enemy target that is hit by this Ultimate, the All-Type RES PEN for the Ultimate DMG dealt will additionally increase by 3%. This effect lasts until the next time an Ultimate is used.
blessings.enhanced: The All-Type RES PEN for Ultimate DMG dealt by characters increases by 25%. For each enemy target hit by the Ultimate that achieves the highest number of enemy hits in a single attack in this battle, the All-Type RES PEN for the Ultimate DMG dealt additionally increases by 3%.

blessings.name: Attachment: Vestibular System
blessings.desc: When characters use Ultimates via Brain in a Vat, their CRIT DMG increases by 80%, lasting until this ability ends.

blessings.name: Imitation: Transmitter Synthesis
blessings.desc: For every 1 Energy that exceeds the characters' Max Energy, charges Brain in a Vat by 0.8%.
blessings.enhanced: For every 1 Energy that exceeds the characters' Max Energy, charges Brain in a Vat by 1.2%.

blessings.name: Implant: Explicit Memory
blessings.desc: After characters use their Ultimate via Brain in a Vat, they gain a Shield equal in strength to 36% of their Max HP, lasting for 2 turns.
blessings.enhanced: After characters use their Ultimate via Brain in a Vat, they gain a Shield equal in strength to 45% of their Max HP, lasting for 3 turns.

blessings.name: Mimesis: Tactile Pathway
blessings.desc: After characters use an attack, they deal Additional DMG to the attacked enemy target(s). For every enemy target that was attacked, increase Additional DMG by 15% of the character's ATK.

For every enemy target that was attacked, increase Additional DMG by 20% of the character's ATK. Up to 5 enemies that have been defeated in the current battle will also be regarded as having been attacked.

blessings.name: Analysis: Subliminal Sensation
blessings.desc: Ultimate DMG dealt by characters increases by 50%, lasting until the end of the first Ultimate they use in battle. After entering battle, characters regenerate energy equal to 60% of their respective Max Energy.
blessings.enhanced: Ultimate DMG dealt by characters increases by 50%. After entering battle, regenerates energy equal to 100% of the character's Max Energy.

blessings.name: Load: Striated Cortex
blessings.desc: If characters' AoE ATK ability only attacks 1 enemy, this ATK will deal an additional set amount of DMG equal to 40% of the original DMG to the attacked enemy target.
blessings.enhanced: If characters' AoE ATK ability only attacks 1 enemy, this ATK will deal an additional set amount of DMG equal to 60% of the original DMG to the attacked enemy target.

blessings.name: Stimulation: Saltatory Conduction

blessings.name: Throne of Engaged Gears

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Sanctuary
blessings.desc: At the end of the turn, characters gain a Shield that can block DMG equal to 10% of their Max HP, lasting for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Quadrangular Pyramid
blessings.desc: Increase the max DMG that can be absorbed by Shields created by characters by 30%.
blessings.enhanced: When characters' gain a Shield, increases the max DMG that can be absorbed by the Shield by 35%.

blessings.name: Interstellar Construct: Inversion Cube
blessings.desc: Increases CRIT Rate of Quake DMG dealt by characters by 20% and CRIT DMG by 50%.
blessings.enhanced: Increases CRIT Rate of Quake DMG dealt by characters by 30% and CRIT DMG by 75%.

blessings.enhanced: Every time an enemy takes DMG from a DoT, all allies restore HP equal to 1.5% of their respective Max HP.

blessings.name: Duke of Omens
blessings.desc: Decreases DEF of Weakness Broken enemy targets by 15%.
blessings.enhanced: Decreases DEF of Weakness Broken enemy targets by 20%.

blessings.name: Novel Motif
blessings.desc: When ally targets Break any enemy target's Weakness, the attacker restores HP by 24% of their Max HP.
blessings.enhanced: When ally targets Break any enemy target's Weakness, the attacker restores HP by 36% of their Max HP.

curios.name: Dimension Reduction Dice
curios.desc: When choosing your Blessings after winning a battle, 1 extra Blessing(s) can be chosen, but the number of available Blessings will be reduced by 1. This Curio will be destroyed once this effect has been triggered 2 time(s).
curios.lore: Nine six-sided dice make up this bizarre pyramidal device. It can continuously reduce the number of dimensions it occupies and exists in the 3-dimensional world as a purely 2-dimensional entity. No one knows who created it or why.

curios.name: Chaos Trametes
curios.desc: When choosing your Blessings after winning a battle, increase the number of free Blessing resets by 1.
curios.lore: Clouds are born from a collection of moisture. They are created for no purpose, and dissipate without forewarning. However, when humans gaze upon the randomly created clouds, they often project their imagination onto these shapes. The Doctors of Chaos do not believe in absolute nihility. All that appears meaningless must have its own irrefutable purpose. Chaos Trametes is their most common Curio item, used to restore the confidence of despairing Self-Annihilators to have purpose in their lives again.

curios.name: Warping Compound Eye
curios.desc: When choosing Blessings after winning a battle, enhance all 1-star Blessings that appear.
curios.lore: There are two types of Nameless. One type enjoys the mysteries of the unknown, while the other tends to trailblaze through the universe with a plan. The latter created the Warping Compound Eyes with the power of Akivili. The light of these gadgets can warp forward to the stars ahead of the user and bring back news from new worlds. For the Nameless who travels alone, Warping Compound Eyes are irreplaceable tools that prevent the Nameless from plunging headfirst into worlds filled with Ambergris cheese.

curios.name: Fruit of the Alien Tree
curios.desc: After winning a battle, revive all downed characters in the current team and restore their HP to their Max HP. This Curio will be destroyed once this effect has been triggered 1 time(s).
curios.lore: This heart-shaped fruit comes from a tree blessed by Yaoshi and is supposedly 50 Amber Eras old. It is unclear whether the fruit would give immortality to those who eat it, but the tree itself is definitely an immortal abomination.

curios.name: Casket of Inaccuracy
curios.desc: Gains 1–2 random Blessings immediately after obtaining this Curio
curios.lore: Each side of this casket can be opened. The spaces that should be overlapping are not overlapped. Due to this unique characteristic, no one can be sure of what will happen when the box is opened. Therefore, it is not recommended to store anything in it.

curios.name: Ambergris Cheese
curios.desc: After winning a battle, all allies restore HP equal to 30% of their respective Max HP.
curios.lore: Once upon a time, a helper robot turned Ambergris of Abundance into cheese on a whim to satisfy its little master's seemingly never-ending appetite. Unexpectedly, the Ambergris Cheese started to multiply on its own. The helper robot and the master worked at full speed, but their digestion still could not keep up with how fast the cheese was multiplying. Therefore, they had to ask for help from a group of passing Mourning Actors and escaped to another world on a gondola. That one world in the cosmos is still stuffed full of delicious cheese to the day, packed so tight that not a single centimeter of space is left. The story teaches an important lesson about not wasting food.

curios.name: Fortune Glue
curios.desc: When choosing your Blessings after winning a battle, all Blessings that appear are guaranteed to be of 3-star rarity. This Curio will be destroyed once this effect has been triggered 1 time(s).
curios.lore: Is luck an ability? Maybe. Can luck be changed? Herta believes it can. That genius invented the "Fortune Glue." Just apply it on your eyelids and you would get a full 24 system hours' worth of good luck. Many at Herta space station were ecstatic to try out this invention. They all had an uneventful day, which shows that it is already lucky to be able to live an ordinary life in a turbulent world.

curios.name: The Parchment That Always Eats
curios.desc: When entering combat, all enemies receive a set amount of DMG equal to 30% of their respective Max HP.
curios.lore: In Herta's Curio list, the hazard level of this parchment is marked as extremely high. It once belonged to a History Fictionologist before ending up at the space station. The parchment feeds on the history of humanity, its greedy tongue churning the collective subconscious of civilization to pieces. Herta forged false memories of the world for it to devour to satisfy its endless gluttony. But one day, this parchment will see through the genius' tricks.

curios.name: Broken Cuckoo Clock
curios.desc: Additionally consume a certain amount of Cosmic Fragments while you have the IPC Cuckoo Clock to obtain this Curio and immediately obtain 999 Cosmic Fragment(s).
curios.lore: A cuckoo clock craftmaster once encountered Terminus. The clock in her hand fell to the ground in her surprise, becoming shattered and broken in Terminus' past. The craftmaster later joined the Omen Vanguards, trying to use cuckoo clocks to interpret Terminus' prophecy. Although she went on to create countless more clocks in her life, she always treasured this broken cuckoo clock. She had already met Terminus when it broke. Terminus had yet to meet her when it broke.

curios.name: Mechanical Cuckoo Clock
curios.desc: When entering combat, consumes 2 Skill Point(s)
curios.lore: After the Second Rubert Rebellion, the IPC had once planned a brutal extermination of all mechanical life across the Cosmos. Fortunately, before the plan was passed, the IPC heard that #76 Screwllum was selected by Nous to join the Genius Society. The IPC then made this mechanical cuckoo clock as a gift to appease the new genius. This gift is very unremarkable in today's view, but that was an era when mechanical beings were persecuted. The birth of the mechanical cuckoo clock itself is a symbol of peace.

curios.name: The Doctor's Robe
curios.desc: When entering combat, regenerates Path Resonance Energy to max and increases Path Resonance DMG by 40%
curios.lore: An incredibly expensive item surfaced on Device IX's dark web one day and grabbed the attention of countless bidders. This robe was reportedly once owned by member #64 of the Genius Society, Dr. Primitive, and supposedly had incredible powers. The seller on the dark web was anonymous. People believed them to be a member of the Galaxy Rangers and kept sending them questions. Regrettably, this mysterious owner did not make any responses even after the item was sold.

curios.name: Society Ticket
curios.desc: Increases the number of Cosmic Fragments received after winning a battle by 75%
curios.lore: Genius Society #56, Elias Salas, once had a beautiful dream. He wished the geniuses of the Society could come together and happily converse about their lives, loves, and dreams. For that purpose, he invented "Society Tickets" and designed an entire system that ensured every new Society member would receive this ticket even after his death. This ticket would instantly teleport the user to a specific dimension decked with festivities. The truth is that every new member after #56 had indeed used their Society Ticket, but not a single one of them had used it at the same time as someone else.

curios.name: Faith Bond
curios.desc: Reduces the Cosmic Fragments required for Blessing Enhancement, Blessing Reset, and for resetting downed characters by 30%.
curios.lore: Interastral Peace Corporation staff members who are promoted to level P40 gain the right to purchase Faith Bonds. These bonds indicate Louis Fleming's affirmation of the individual staff and come with a sacred vow: The staff now have a place in the Amber Lord's destined achievement of Preservation. One person's abilities amount to nothing, their wealth also amounts to nothing, and their faith is like a single particle of dust in the wide starry seas. However, generations of humanity will join together and ultimately obtain the power to protect the entire universe.

curios.name: Robe of The Beauty
curios.desc: Increases DMG dealt by all allies by 16% for every 100 Cosmic Fragment(s) you own
curios.lore: The entire universe bowed before the grace of the Knights of Beauty while they still traversed the skies. These noble knights who chased beauty wore resplendent gold and silver armor, and donned magnificent robes woven from silk and starlight. They had divinely beautiful features under their helmets. Even in the current era when the Beauty had already faded, those who had once witnessed the magnificence of the knights still believe Idrila will one day return.

curios.name: Gold Coin of Discord
curios.desc: Upon entering a new Domain, gain Cosmic Fragments equal to 6% of the Cosmic Fragments currently in possession.
curios.lore: Not all planets opened their arms and welcomed the expansion of the Interastral Peace Corporation's commercial empire. While the cosmic map kept expanding, there were always rare exceptions that refused the IPC's beneficence. "Thank you," they stated, "but we don't need credits. We can look after ourselves just fine." The representative of the IPC would usually shrug at these statements, then casually destroy the root of that planet's commercial system — it is usually based on gold.

curios.name: Void Wick Trimmer
curios.desc: After obtaining this Curio, randomly repairs up to 2 destroyed Curio(s) and restores their remaining uses to default.
curios.lore: Few would use this candle wick trimmer on real candles. This is usually reserved for purposes more cruel, dark, and painful. This trimmer does not cut anything material. It cuts the heat within a living organism's heart — the motivation named "passion." If the Void Wick Trimmer trims at your heart, you will feel no pain, only apathy.

curios.name: Omniscient Capsule
curios.desc: Destructible objects will appear more frequently and rewards obtained from them are doubled
curios.lore: There is a group in the Intelligentsia Guild that believes science was originally the same as magic, that advanced science is magic and rigorous magic is science. They drew inspiration from ancient fantastic mythologies and created the Omniscient Capsule, a light-weight and convenient storage gadget. The Intelligentsia Guild planned for the Omniscient Capsule to ultimately lead to independent demiplanes, thus obtaining infinite space beyond the advanced spatial compression technologies currently in use... And they are still trying.

curios.name: Record from Beyond the Sky
curios.desc: When entering combat, all characters will nullify all DMG received except for DoT until after they are attacked, and cannot be debuffed for 3 turn(s)
curios.lore: The Beyond-the-Sky Choir lost their faith when Ena the Order was absorbed by Xipe. The once-solemn chords fell silent and the stars turned mute. Only a few records, made by the Choir's devoted audiences remain in this world today. When these records are placed within specific phonographs, you will hear songs from the end of the universe, sounds that contain the beauty of Order. The last Phonograph of Order was destroyed in the Emperor's War, and now the thick layer of dust on the records are protests to that soundless era.

curios.name: Entropic Die
curios.desc: Randomly enhances 2 Blessing(s) immediately after obtaining this Curio.
curios.lore: Entropic Dice are common in the universe and cause countless tiny but malevolent disturbances. To use it, you grab the die tightly and think of any meaningful sentence in your head, then as you throw the die, think about the food you want to eat the most. You will receive unexpected wealth if the die lands on a certain number and wonderful love on another number, but the ends you will meet for other numbers include illness, bad luck, curses, and lifelong rain. Despite this, many people still love to play with these dice, and happily declare that these items are just a joke made by the Masked Fools.

curios.name: Shining Trapezohedron Die
curios.desc: Replaces all Curios currently in possession (including this Curio) with random Curios.
curios.lore: This die has irregular sides and a wondrous light that twirls unrestrained within it. It is said to be the seal of a horrible and indescribable evil god, and one must avoid contact with it in dark places at all costs. Some people did not believe in the above myth and insisted on staying in a dark room with the die, only to find that the light within the die itself cannot be blocked out. That is how the famous Shining Trapezohedron Die Paradox came to be — You cannot prove something that cannot be proven.

curios.name: Sealing Wax of Preservation
curios.desc: Randomly gains 1 Blessing of Preservation after obtaining this Curio. When choosing your Blessings after winning a battle, there is a greatly increased chance for Blessings of Preservation to appear.
curios.lore: There is a saying amongst the dejected Self-Annihilators that the universe has no purpose and humans are nothing in the eyes of the Aeons. If the Aeons truly stand above all lifeforms and rule supreme, then why would they care about the everyday concerns of mortals? The existence of the sleeping and shapeless IX is proof of that. To show the Self-Annihilators that the Aeons do care, the Doctors of Chaos combined the demon god crafts of the occult monks to create the Sealing Wax of Aeons. It is said that stamping with this Sealing Wax will attract a glimpse from the corresponding Aeon from across space and time — There are no successful examples yet, but some Self-Annihilators did regain their faith in the universe, Aeons, and everything else after stamping with this sealing wax.

curios.name: Sealing Wax of Elation
curios.desc: Randomly gains 1 Blessing of Elation after obtaining this Curio. When choosing your Blessings after winning a battle, there is a greatly increased chance for Blessings of Elation to appear.
